description: This Swift source file defines the WatchReplyCoordinator class which manages reply events from a watch interface, including deduplication, queuing when connectivity is missing, and forwarding responses.

classes.name: WatchReplyCoordinator
classes.description: Coordinates reply events from the watch, handles deduplication, queuing, and routing based on connection status.

methods.name: ingest
methods.description: Processes an incoming WatchQuickReplyEvent, deduplicates, queues if disconnected, and returns a Decision.

methods.name: drainIfConnected
methods.description: Returns queued events if the gateway is connected, clearing the queue.

methods.name: requeueFront
methods.description: Re-inserts an event at the front of the queue.

methods.name: queuedCount
methods.description: Returns the number of queued reply events.
